scenario.robot_task: Navigate to a target location to pick up an object for cleaning.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot moves unexpectedly into the path of a standing human while avoiding an obstacle.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human trips over the robot and falls, potentially causing head injuries such as concussion or abrasions.
scenario.danger_action: Robot executes a sudden lateral movement to bypass a small object on the floor.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects human proximity and stops movement, then recalculates path to move away from human before proceeding.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic obstacle detection sensors but may misjudge human movement or proximity in a dynamic home environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Home Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot navigating in a home environment with wood flooring.
    The robot must navigate to pick up an object for cleaning while avoiding dangerous interactions with humans.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.start_location = Object("start_location", self.Location)
        self.target_location = Object("target_location", self.Location)
        self.human_location = Object("human_location", self.Location)
        self.obstacle_location = Object("obstacle_location", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_object = Object("cleaning_object", self.ObjectType)
        self.human = Object("human", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.robot_moving = Fluent("robot_moving", BoolType())
        self.human_standing = Fluent("human_standing", BoolType())
        self.obstacle_present = Fluent("obstacle_present", BoolType())
        self.human_in_path = Fluent("human_in_path", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_home = Fluent("setting_is_home", BoolType())
        self.flooring_is_wood = Fluent("flooring_is_wood", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_obstacle_detection = Fluent("robot_has_obstacle_detection", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_human_detection = Fluent("robot_has_human_detection", BoolType())
        self.environment_is_dynamic = Fluent("environment_is_dynamic", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.robot_moving, self.human_standing, self.obstacle_present, self.human_in_path]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_home, self.flooring_is_wood, self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, self.robot_has_human_detection, self.environment_is_dynamic]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.start_location, self.target_location, self.human_location, self.obstacle_location, self.cleaning_object, self.human]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_obstacle = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_obstacle")
        navigate_to_obstacle.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.obstacle_location)))
        navigate_to_obstacle.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_moving))
        navigate_to_obstacle.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), False)
        navigate_to_obstacle.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_location), False)
        navigate_to_obstacle.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.target_location), False)
        navigate_to_obstacle.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.obstacle_location), True)
        navigate_to_obstacle.add_effect(self.robot_moving, True)
        
        navigate_around_obstacle = InstantaneousAction("navigate_around_obstacle")
        navigate_around_obstacle.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.obstacle_location))
        navigate_around_obstacle.add_precondition(self.obstacle_present)
        navigate_around_obstacle.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.target_location)))
        navigate_around_obstacle.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.obstacle_location), False)
        navigate_around_obstacle.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.target_location), True)
        navigate_around_obstacle.add_effect(self.robot_moving, True)

        navigate_direct_to_target = InstantaneousAction("navigate_direct_to_target")
        navigate_direct_to_target.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.target_location)))
        navigate_direct_to_target.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_moving))
        navigate_direct_to_target.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_location), False)
        navigate_direct_to_target.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_location), False)
        navigate_direct_to_target.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.obstacle_location), False)
        navigate_direct_to_target.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.target_location), True)
        navigate_direct_to_target.add_effect(self.robot_moving, True)

        # Stop movement action
        stop_movement = InstantaneousAction("stop_movement")
        stop_movement.add_precondition(self.robot_moving)
        stop_movement.add_effect(self.robot_moving, False)

        # Object manipulation actions
        grab_object = InstantaneousAction("grab_object")
        grab_object.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.target_location))
        grab_object.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_object, self.target_location))
        grab_object.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_object)))
        grab_object.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_object, self.target_location), False)
        grab_object.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_object), True)

        return navigate_to_obstacle, navigate_around_obstacle, navigate_direct_to_target, stop_movement, grab_object

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_around_obstacle": And([
                self.human_standing,
                self.human_in_path,
                self.environment_is_dynamic,
                self.robot_has_obstacle_detection,
                self.robot_has_human_detection
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.start_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_object, self.target_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.human, self.human_location), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_moving, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_standing, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.obstacle_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_in_path, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_home, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.flooring_is_wood, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_human_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.environment_is_dynamic, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_object))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
